He who often walks by the river may eventually get his shoes wet.

If Lin Yuan were greedy for this way of earning Merit Points, sooner or later, he’d run into big trouble.

…

Battlefield C24763.

Lin Yuan’s Yin God rode on a spaceship, swiftly advancing in a certain direction.

...

“Hmm… Wonderful fluctuations of space….”

Lin Yuan took a deep breath, reveling in the continuously fluctuating spatial forces around him, his mind exceptionally pleased.

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to sense the spatial fluctuations, deepening your comprehension of the Space Rules…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to sense the spatial fluctuations, deepening your comprehension of the Space Rules…]

…

[Your Against-Heaven’s Understanding allows you to sense the spatial fluctuations, deepening your comprehension of the Space Rules…]

…

The Taiyin Primordial Spirit shared consciousness with Lin Yuan and naturally possessed Against-Heaven’s Understanding; at this moment, entering the Battlefield of Different Races, it was deepening its understanding and feeling of the Space Rules almost every moment.

“So far, I haven’t encountered any Different Species…”

Lin Yuan glanced around and shook his head slightly.

This was the norm for the Alien Battlefield, except during certain special periods; most of the time, you wouldn’t encounter any Different Species.

If one wanted to find Different Species, they should head to the center of the battlefield, where armies of strong individuals from both the Human Race and the Heiyuan Clan were gathered, and wars could break out at any moment.

Like Lin Yuan who, not long after entering the battlefield, had encountered several strong members of the Heiyuan Clan, and had also obtained the inheritance of a Human Race Eighth-Rank Evolver…

That was not normal; it could already be considered a huge stroke of luck.

“That should be the location of the Permanent Spatial Rift in this battlefield…”

Lin Yuan’s gaze shifted, looking in a certain direction.

He faintly sensed that there were extremely violent spatial forces surging over there.

“The Main World is almost perfect, its space is solid, nearly indestructible. Even if I forcibly tear open the space using my comprehension of spatial laws, the rift would heal very quickly.”

“As for the formation of a Permanent Spatial Rift…”

Lin Yuan was somewhat unable to understand the reasons behind the formation of the Eternal Spatial Rift, attributing it to the might of Supreme Beings being too powerful.

“According to the information, next to that Permanent Spatial Rift, there are strong members of both the Human Race and the Heiyuan Clan guarding it, and one must have the approval of either the Human Race or the Heiyuan Clan to approach and comprehend it.”

This wasn’t a problem for Lin Yuan; when the time came, he only needed to reveal his Human Race identity to get through.

In fact.

Many Evolvers entering the Battlefield of Different Races did so with the goal of comprehending the Space Rules, and the same was true for the Heiyuan Clan.

Most strong individuals did not have the terrifying comprehension abilities like Lin Yuan, and they couldn’t break through just by closing up in meditation.

They could only rely on entering such dangerous places to try to advance further.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

In front of him, wisps of spatial power emerged, constantly converging and intertwining, forming a mysterious spatial model.

Time passed unknowably.

A tower-shaped spatial model was completed, and in an instant, with the tower as the center, the space all around suddenly became stable.

“The nine-hundred thirty-eighth type of spatial model…”

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, a smile on his face.

Among the nine hundred sixty-five basic spatial models, each type of spatial model has its special use.

For example, the tower-shaped spatial model that Lin Yuan had just condensed is capable of suppressing space.

If this spatial model is applied and comprehended to the extreme, one could solidify the space within a billion miles with a wave of the hand, prohibiting the use of many spatial powers such as instant movement.

“There are still twenty-seven basic spatial models left…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred, and the tower-shaped spatial model in front of him dispersed, and the space around him immediately returned to normal.

“In at most a month, I will be able to completely comprehend the basic spatial models…”

“By then, nothing will hinder the opening of the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter, and I can fully step into the Seventh Rank…”

Lin Yuan was quite satisfied.

Of course.

The reason he could comprehend at such a rapid speed

was mainly because of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit being in the Alien Battlefield, granting him an equivalent comprehension of space.

This allowed Lin Yuan to significantly advance the pace at which he comprehended the nine hundred sixty-five types of basic spatial models.

“Seventh Stage Martial Tao…”

Lin Yuan looked forward to it greatly, imagining the importance of this phase. Creating his own Inner World was the foundation.

And according to Lin Yuan’s comprehension of other Evolution Paths, to open an Inner World, one needs at least to be in the period of breaking through from the Seventh Rank to the Eighth Layer.

As for opening an Inner World between the Sixth Rank and Seventh Rank, throughout the two-plus million years of the Starry Sea Era, there have been very few specific cases, each one an unreplicable stroke of great fortune.

…

Battlefield C24763.

“We’ve arrived.”

Lin Yuan stopped the spaceship.

“`

Not far off, there was a mountain range floating in the air, snaking tens of thousands of miles, emitting terrifying waves of energy.

As Lin Yuan approached, he actively released the aura of his Battlefield Pass.

It wasn’t long before.

A tall man clad in black armor flew down.

“Brother, what brings you to this battlefield?” he asked warmly.

The armored man approached, seeming quite friendly.

Since Lin Yuan could release the aura of the Battlefield Pass, it proved that he belonged to the Human Race; Different Species had no means to imitate the aura of the battlefield pass, not even those peak clans could do it.

“Are you planning to head to the center of the battlefield to have a good fight with those despicable members of the Heiyuan Clan?”

The armored man looked at Lin Yuan excitedly, “Don’t worry, follow behind me when the great battle erupts, you definitely won’t encounter any problems.”

Most of the human evolvers who come to the Battlefields of Different Races aim to fight against Different Species on the battlefield.

The benefits are too many, killing a member of a Different Species, gaining the treasures on their person, as well as Merit Points determined by the Goddess of Freedom.

As for comprehending Space Rules? That’s mostly just incidental.

“No, I’m preparing to head to that Permanent Spatial Rift to comprehend the Space Rules…”

Lin Yuan immediately shared his objective.

Clearly, the armored man was keen on slaying Different Species and was now thinking of roping Lin Yuan into his group.

“I see…”

An obvious look of disappointment crossed the man’s face.

“Then come with me.”

The armored man turned and flew towards the floating mountain range behind him.

Lin Yuan immediately followed.

Soon.

The two entered the hovering mountain range.

“Next to the Permanent Spatial Rift, half of it is occupied by the Heiyuan Clan, you need to be cautious when you comprehend there, don’t get too engrossed…”

The armored man cautioned.

On the Alien Battlefield, the encounters between the Human Race and the Heiyuan Clan still retain sanity; there were some areas by default where fighting was not allowed.

One of these areas was around that Permanent Spatial Rift.

Both Human Race evolvers and Heiyuan Clan powerhouses who went there did so to comprehend Space Rules,

Therefore, for tens of thousands of years, both sides by default forbid initiating conflict in that area.

Those wishing to engage in battle should go to the central battlefield, where a large number of powerhouses from both clans congregate; you can fight to your heart’s content there.

But—

This was only an unwritten rule.

It wasn’t unbreakable.

If you truly regarded that area as a safe zone,

You would truly be foolish.

That’s why the armored man gave such a warning.

“I understand.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He had made sufficient preparations before coming here.

“Good.”

“Follow me.”

The armored man led Lin Yuan to a teleportation area.

From here, one could immediately reach the side of that Permanent Spatial Rift.

Hum!!

Teleportation began.

Lin Yuan felt a violent fluctuation of spatial forces all around him.

By the time things started to settle down, he had already arrived at another location.

“Over there?”

Lin Yuan looked up and saw a pitch-black ‘crack’ not too far away.

It was filled with a murky gas, vast amounts of space force churned, along with Space Rules constantly fluctuating.

“This is the Permanent Spatial Rift in this space battlefield…”

The armored man also looked over and explained in a low voice, “This Permanent Spatial Rift was caused by the human evolvers wielding Supreme Weapons, so it’s not very large.”

“However, in Large Alien Battlefields, where Supreme Beings personally tear open Permanent Spatial Rifts, they can reach tens of thousands of miles, hundreds of millions of miles, and even billions of miles wide…”

“It’s said that such vast spatial rifts often have traces of ‘visitors from other worlds,’ and they are extremely dangerous…”

While introducing, the armored man marveled.

However.

There were things the armored man didn’t know.

At this very moment.

Lin Yuan’s heart was not calm.

Because when he looked at that Permanent Spatial Rift not far away, which was only over ten meters wide,

In the depths of his mind, the towering, magnificent Door to the Myriad Realms slightly trembled.
